en.about.author: Author & maintainer
en.about.bind.d: .ds/bindings.md maps each spec to this repo's own components. You keep owning your components.
en.about.lead: A design system that never injects code. One source of visual truth, shared by humans and AI agents.
en.about.offline: This panel never makes an automatic network request. Its fonts and icons are embedded in the file. The links above only open if you click them.
en.about.ref.d: Plain HTML+CSS components you open in a browser — what designers look at and AI agents read.
en.about.title: About
en.about.truth.d: Tokens and component specs in the design system repo, compiled and validated on every release.
en.app.title: Design System
en.attn.dirty.body: Commit them first so the adoption commit stays clean.
en.attn.dirty.title: Uncommitted changes
en.attn.drift.contract: Contract file — should match the template.
en.attn.drift.living: The bindings map has evolved. That is expected (CLAUDE.md §4) — send it to the designer so it can land in the next release.
en.attn.drift.title: was edited by hand
en.attn.halfwired.title: Level 1 is half-wired
en.attn.legacy.body: Files from the v1/v2 package are still here. These are not your portal's own code.
en.attn.legacy.title: Leftovers from an older design system
en.attn.selfupdate.body: A newer version ships inside the design system.
en.attn.selfupdate.title: This panel is out of date
en.attn.unmanaged.body: This repo was installed by an older panel, so there is no install receipt. Drift detection, exact revert and rollback all depend on it.
en.attn.unmanaged.title: Installed without a receipt
en.attn.update.title: Update available
en.cr.clipboard: The full text is on your clipboard.
en.cr.lead: Your change is packaged as a change request, then your mail client opens.

en.cr.title: Send to designer
en.diff.backupNote: Your version is copied to .ds/.trash/ before anything is replaced.
en.diff.restoreNote: Restoring will replace this with the template from panel version
en.diff.title: Comparison
en.docs.lead: The component gallery and every document, opened straight from the installed version.
en.docs.title: Docs & gallery
en.health.doctor.hint: Read-only. It never writes a single file.
en.health.drift.none: Every managed file matches its template.
en.health.lead: Every check here is read-only unless you press a button yourself.
en.health.receipt.hint: Exactly everything this panel has ever touched, with hashes.
en.health.repo.hint: For when the design system repo moves host.
en.health.uninstall.hint: Removes everything this panel added. Your code, components and git history are untouched.
en.home.notInstalled.body: The design system is not installed in this repo yet. A Level 0 install changes nothing in your build and reverts in one commit.
en.home.stack.note: This panel's own UI uses Lucide icons — tool chrome only. Your product uses Tabler, per the spec above.
en.home.stack.title: Your product stack

en.md.mermaid: Mermaid diagram — paste the source below into a Mermaid viewer to see it drawn.
en.more.closed: Panel closed. The server has stopped — you can close this tab.
en.plan.lead: Review every step. Nothing has run yet.
en.plan.title: This is exactly what will happen
en.prompts.lead: Ready-made prompts for your AI coding agent. Each one already carries this repo's design system rules and adapts to your adoption level.
en.prompts.locked: Install the design system first — the full prompt library appears here afterwards.
en.prompts.stack: Prompts target your product stack: Fustat · Tabler · .ts-* text styles
en.prompts.tip: Most precise on the latest Claude Opus with reasoning effort set to high.
en.prompts.title: AI prompt library
en.setup.commit.hint: Leave unchecked to try it out first.
en.setup.done: All set. Open your editor and work as usual — the AI now reads your design system rules automatically.
en.setup.installed: The design system is already installed here. Re-running is harmless — satisfied steps are skipped.
en.setup.l1code.hint: Level 1 touches 2 lines of build config, so it needs a go-ahead from whoever maintains the design system.
en.setup.lead: Not an installer — a guided version of the official tutorial. You always see the full plan before anything runs.
en.setup.level0.desc: Zero risk. AI grounding on, build untouched.
en.setup.level1.desc: Adds 2 lines to your config. Live tokens + dark mode. Needs an access code.
en.setup.repoUrl.hint: Point this at any repo that holds this design system.
en.setup.title: Install the design system
en.tour.drift.d: The panel notices, shows you the diff, and offers to send it to the designer so it lands in the next release.
en.tour.drift.t: If you edit something by hand
en.tour.hero.d: At a glance: installed or not, your adoption level, the design system version, and the pinned commit.
en.tour.lang.d: Switch ID/EN anytime. Light, dark, or follow-system themes live in the three-dot menu.
en.tour.level.d: Level 0 is zero risk: AI grounding on, your build untouched. Level 1 adds only 2 marked lines.
en.tour.nav.d: The navigation floats at the bottom. A yellow dot means that section needs your attention.
en.tour.process.d: This button changes nothing straight away. It shows every command and file first — you decide.
en.tour.stats.d: These numbers are read live from the installed design system folder — so they cannot go stale.
en.ver.impact.none: No tokens or specs are removed. Safe.
en.ver.lead: See the impact first, then update. Always reversible.
en.ver.noRollback: No rollback point yet — one is recorded automatically on your first update.
en.ver.rollback.hint: Return to the previous design system version.
en.ver.upToDate: You are on the latest version.
